FX-BCAST-001.says: NTSC, reduce luminance, 110 IRE, the settings as they start: the three brightest rows of yellow (pure yellow is about 131 IRE) and cyan and the top row of green are darkened until their signal is 110 IRE, keeping their colour; everything else is safe and stays as it is.

FX-BCAST-002.says: Reduce saturation: the same unsafe pixels keep their brightness and are made greyer until their signal is 110 IRE.

FX-BCAST-003.says: Key out unsafe: the unsafe pixels are cleared, showing what is behind; everything else stays exactly as it is.

FX-BCAST-004.says: Key out safe: the other way round, only the unsafe pixels are left, to show where they are.

FX-BCAST-005.says: PAL: no set-up, so black is 0 IRE rather than 7.5 and the limit allows a little less colour signal; the same pixels are unsafe as on NTSC, each brought down a little further.

FX-BCAST-006.says: NTSC at 90 IRE: even the white and the light greys are above the limit, so they are darkened too.

FX-BCAST-007.says: NTSC at 120 IRE, the loosest limit: only the two brightest rows of yellow and cyan are brought down.

FX-BCAST-008.says: PAL at 95 IRE, reduce saturation: the white's brightness alone is past the limit and it has no colour to take away, so it becomes the grey at the limit; the bright colours lose colour, keeping their brightness.

FX-BCAST-009.says: The limit keyed from 90 IRE at frame 0 to 120 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-BCAST-006, frame 2 is 105 IRE, frame 4 is FX-BCAST-007.

FX-BCAST-010.says: FX-BCAST-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-BCAST-011.says: Maximum signal amplitude 121, above 120. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BCAST-012.says: Maximum signal amplitude 89, below 90. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BCAST-013.says: Locale "secam", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BCAST-014.says: Locale "NTSC": the word is exact, so capitals are not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BCAST-015.says: Method "reduce", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
